8. Consider the following trained Decision Tree with features 𝑥1 and
   𝑥2.

   The output for a new data point with features 𝑥1 = 12 and 𝑥2 =
  3 is _______________.
   Answer: 14
   At Root Node: 𝑥1 ≤10?, it will Right (as 12 ≤10 is False)
   At Decision Node: 𝑥2 ≤5?, it will go Left (as 3 ≤5 is True)
   Target Location: Leaf Node 2

   For Regression tree: prediction is the mean (average) of the
    training instances that fall within that specific region (leaf node)


                                  10+14+18   42
   Predicted Value 𝑦̂ = 𝑚𝑒𝑎𝑛(𝑦) =     =  = 14.0
                                        3       3
